summary: The revision establishes a simple 185 x 178 x 120 mm shell envelope, but it does not visually establish the required PC-component interfaces, controls, dual-side ventilation, or developed service provisions. One dimensional check passes; two visible requirements fail; the remaining interface and manufacturing details are not verified.

checks.description: The shell is a coherent single body without visible floating fragments, but the assembly is visibly incomplete as an enclosure: it is essentially an open rectangular shell with no closure, internal retention structure, or developed interfaces.

evidence.description: The isometric view directly shows a simple open shell with continuous outer walls but no internal assembly structure or closure components.

checks.description: No motherboard reference envelope, standoffs, mounting-hole pattern, retention features, or identifiable rear-I/O opening is visible, so Mini-ITX fit and accessibility cannot be established.

evidence.description: The isometric preview shows an empty shell and does not display Mini-ITX mounting or rear-I/O interface geometry.

checks.description: The AXP120-X67 envelope and its relation to a mounted motherboard and side intake are not represented, so cooler fit and intake clearance cannot be visually established.

evidence.description: The front view shows only the shell profile, with no cooler envelope or located side-intake clearance region.

checks.description: No GPU envelope, I/O bracket interface, PCIe riser location, or power-cable bend-space representation is visible; the required fit cannot be established.

evidence.description: The empty-shell isometric view contains no visible GPU, bracket, riser, or cable-routing interface geometry.

checks.description: Neither Flex ATX/1U nor SFX envelopes are shown, and there is no identifiable PSU retention, AC inlet, airflow, or cable-routing geometry; PSU fit cannot be established.

evidence.description: The front view shows no PSU-specific opening, mount, airflow path, or cable-routing provision.

checks.description: No externally accessible power-button opening or button feature is visible on the modeled shell, and no internal routing feature is represented.

evidence.description: The visible exterior shell surfaces contain no power-button feature or opening.

checks.description: The cited views show the intended rectangular enclosure envelope, while supporting geometry inspection reports a 185 x 178 x 120 mm bounding box, corresponding to 3.9516 L and therefore not exceeding 4.0 L.

evidence.description: The isometric image visibly establishes the rectangular external envelope whose exact extents are supported by the inspected bounding box.

checks.description: The two sides do not both have large ventilation openings: the back view shows one large framed opening, while the opposite visible side is a solid uninterrupted panel.

evidence.description: The back view directly shows a large rectangular opening retained by a continuous structural border.
The isometric view shows the contrasting opposite side as solid, contradicting the requirement for obvious large openings on both sides.

checks.description: The shell appears continuous and free of visible floating fragments, but the images and available facts do not establish the 2.4 mm wall-thickness target or confirm print-ready FDM wall behavior throughout.

evidence.description: The isometric view shows a visually continuous shell without obvious detached fragments, but does not prove wall thickness.
The bottom view shows a continuous planar face but provides no direct wall-thickness or print-validation evidence.

checks.description: A large framed rear opening provides general access space, but the views do not establish distinct provisions for motherboard I/O, GPU I/O, power, or attachment of a removable service panel.

evidence.description: The back view directly shows one broad framed opening, but no differentiated I/O, power, or removable-panel attachment geometry.
The left view shows a solid panel without visible service-access or panel-fastening provisions.
